notes: Brand new PR, opened 2026-09-06T22:58:23Z by Alek99 (MEMBER). Largest of the six new PRs (25 files, +2503/-118). Part of the Sep 5-7 performance-PR batch; speeds up `reflex deploy` preparation by stabilizing dependency-install cache fingerprints (avoiding needless reinstalls from process/formatting-order noise), skipping redundant sidecar recompression, caching successful version checks for 24h, and adding an opt-in `REFLEX_FRONTEND_BUILD_CACHE` that reuses deterministic production Vite output (disabled by default). Reports up to ~78% less prep time on an unchanged-frontend fixture.

Two open, unaddressed findings on the current head (author has not yet replied to either): (1) greptile — the new one-day `_VERSION_CHECK_INTERVAL` constant lacks the repo-required human-readable duration comment, same style nit as on #7050; (2) cubic (P1) — on Windows, `frontend_build_lock` is a documented no-op, so concurrent `reflex export`/deploy invocations can still race on the shared `.web` workspace even though POSIX now serializes them via a persistent lock. This second one is a real, not-yet-fixed cross-platform correctness gap, unlike the other bot findings in this batch which were all fixed.

Four other threads are resolved: greptile and cubic both raised concurrent-build workspace-mixing risk and the version-cache-never-expires bug from the initial commit; both were addressed in the 4da5154 follow-up commit that adds a persistent reentrant POSIX workspace lock and a 24h expiry for the version-check cache.
